title: Active Sellers
flavorText: COUNT(*) in HAVING lets you filter groups by how many rows they contain — useful for finding popular items.
narrative: Find products that appear in more than 2 sales transactions — the active movers.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'Jan','Datapad',3,899.97),(2,'Jan','Power Cell',10,199.90),(3,'Feb','Datapad',5,1499.95),(4,'Feb','Logic Board',2,179.98),(5,'Mar','Optic Lens',1,149.99),(6,'Mar','Servo Motor',4,220.00),(7,'Mar','Datapad',2,599.98),(8,'Apr','Power Cell',20,399.80),(9,'Apr','Logic Board',5,449.95),(10,'Apr','Steel Cable',50,425.00);
task: Find products that appear in more than 1 sale transaction. Show product name and transaction count, ordered by count descending.

hints.text: GROUP BY product, then use HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 to keep only products with multiple transactions.
SELECT product, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM sales GROUP BY product HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY tx_count DESC;
SELECT product, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM sales GROUP BY product HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY tx_count DESC;
